comment: Panel lettering reads OSC sender over the button the code wires to PARAM_SEND and OSC receiver over PARAM_RECV (PyladesWidget.cpp:318-326 against res/Pylades.svg); the two are the right way round. The three buttons along the bottom carry no lettering; their names come from the configParam strings at Pylades.cpp:433-437. The receiving and sending flags at Pylades.cpp:322-324 are declared without an initialiser and onReset does not set them, so the state the module wakes in is whatever the allocation left; in practice both read off. The module has no ports of any kind. The theme item the plugin puts on every module's menu is left out as cosmetic.
